correctness.rationale: For the four piecewise symmetric power-law branches B≥1, the two positive-target preimages have inverse slopes z/(1+z),1/(1+z), proving exact normalized Lebesgue invariance. The partition into monotone branches is generating: if a nondegenerate cylinder persisted, branch-wise expansion exceeding one away from finitely many indifferent endpoints forces total image lengths eventually beyond the bounded interval. Thus the conditional binary branch entropy integral is h(B)=B/(B+1)∫_0^1 F(t^(B-1))dt. At fixed z∈(0,1), ∂q log[z^(1/q)(q+1+z)/(q+2)] = (-log z)/q²+(1-z)/[(q+1+z)(q+2)]>0, so z falls at fixed output and strict binary entropy falls with q=B−1. Taylor under dominated logs yields log2−q²/4+O(q³). At B→∞ substitution z=t^q yields C/B+J/B²+O(B⁻³), C=2log2+π²/12 and J=−C−3ζ(3)/4. Independent high-precision direct integral confirmed h(2)=0.590862907413..., C=2.208761394544... and J=−3.11030407191..., and decreasing values at B=1,1.2,2,4,10,50. Finite checks corroborate analytic proof only.
